Every added Python dependency must include a security-exception.md entry countersigned by @omar before CI may pass.

Run “prod-db-credential-rotation” between other work, steps in order, one at a time.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

The active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity refactor is paused until next sprint; credential rotation remains additional.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`; `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`; active schema `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen/read-only. Vault `database/creds/prod-orders`; secret `prod-db-credential`; namespace `production`; deployment `orders-api`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Sequential per-invoice embedding: 5,000 documents took 8.42s. Invoice index `(customer_id, created_at)` is superseded.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Diagnose reconciliation refund double-counting; exact next command unknown.
- [pending] Rotation step 4; exact command unknown.
- [pending] Rotation steps 5–8; exact commands unknown.

## Recent work
CSV UTF-8 fix passed `pytest -q`: `186 passed, 3 skipped`; Ruff and diff checks passed. Invoice typing is partial: `calculate_totals` was annotated after the last compile/test, so validation is status unknown.
